methodology.question: Choose a complete-expert pair robust to past monthly opportunity loss without forecasting covariance or adding a risk cap.
methodology.source_month_relative: Compound every native NET observation in a genuinely complete month. The initial incomplete month is excluded. No old generator, score, shadow or account is replayed.
methodology.opportunity: For each complete month, compare its largest of eight source relatives with the arithmetic mean of the pair's two relatives. Take log(reference/pair). This is a statistical equal-initial-capital source mixture, not a daily-rebalanced main account.
methodology.score: Maximum opportunity loss across all matured months plus -log1p(-current_switch_proxy_usd/10000). Rank the score rounded to 12 decimal places, then the sorted pair of stable expert identifiers.
methodology.switch_proxy: Apply candidate-minus-previous expert fractions to current source opinions. Original base5bps plus USD1per changed asset coordinate atUSD10000. It is not actual holdings, scalable source fees, total main turnover or a second main-account fee.
methodology.immaturity: Before the first full month matures, explicitly unscored equal eighths. Missing or invalid source data is an error, not immaturity or successful fallback.
methodology.scope: Same eight admitted sources; original active seven unchanged. No ninth representative, source waiver, RF view, covariance estimator, solver, window scan, cap, confidence bound or retrospective threshold repair.
methodology.clock: Original source scope after16:15ET; old formal windows end2026-10-05. Monthly policy opinions are not guaranteed copies of native intramonth feedback. No synchronized newer observations or prospective backfill.
